mapper.select: SELECT id, worker_id, worker_ip, worker_port, hostname, supported_task_types, max_task_count, current_task_count, status, last_heartbeat_at, total_tasks_done, total_tasks_failed, registered_at, updated_at, is_deleted FROM asts_worker_node WHERE worker_id = #{workerId} AND is_deleted = 0 LIMIT 1

SELECT id, worker_id, task_type_key, worker_ip, worker_port, hostname, supported_task_types, max_task_count, current_task_count, status, last_heartbeat_at, total_tasks_done, total_tasks_failed, registered_at, updated_at, is_deleted FROM asts_worker_node WHERE status = 'ONLINE' AND is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY last_heartbeat_at DESC
mapper.update: INSERT INTO asts_worker_node (id, worker_id, worker_ip, worker_port, hostname, status, last_heartbeat_at, registered_at, updated_at, is_deleted) VALUES (#{id}, #{workerId}, #{workerIp}::inet, #{workerPort}, #{hostname}, 'ONLINE', #{heartbeatTime}, #{heartbeatTime}, #{heartbeatTime}, 0) ON CONFLICT (worker_id) DO UPDATE SET hostname = EXCLUDED.hostname, worker_ip = EXCLUDED.worker_ip, worker_port = EXCLUDED.worker_port, status = 'ONLINE', last_heartbeat_at = EXCLUDED.last_heartbeat_at, updated_at = EXCLUDED.updated_at WHERE asts_worker_node.is_deleted = 0
mapper.select: SELECT id, worker_id, task_type_key, worker_ip, worker_port, hostname, supported_task_types, max_task_count, current_task_count, status, last_heartbeat_at, total_tasks_done, total_tasks_failed, registered_at, updated_at, is_deleted FROM asts_worker_node WHERE worker_ip = #{workerIp}::inet AND task_type_key = #{taskTypeKey} AND is_deleted = 0 LIMIT 1
mapper.update: INSERT INTO asts_worker_node ( id, worker_id, task_type_key, worker_ip, worker_port, hostname, supported_task_types, max_task_count, current_task_count, status, last_heartbeat_at, total_tasks_done, total_tasks_failed, registered_at, updated_at, is_deleted ) VALUES ( #{worker.id}, #{worker.workerId}, #{worker.taskTypeKey}, #{worker.workerIp}::inet, #{worker.workerPort}, #{worker.hostname}, #{worker.supportedTaskTypes}, #{worker.maxTaskCount}, COALESCE(#{worker.currentTaskCount}, 0), 'ONLINE', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, COALESCE(#{worker.totalTasksDone}, 0), COALESCE(#{worker.totalTasksFailed}, 0), CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, 0 ) ON CONFLICT (worker_ip, task_type_key) WHERE is_deleted = 0 DO UPDATE SET worker_id = EXCLUDED.worker_id, hostname = EXCLUDED.hostname, worker_port = EXCLUDED.worker_port, supported_task_types = EXCLUDED.supported_task_types, max_task_count = EXCLUDED.max_task_count, current_task_count = EXCLUDED.current_task_count, status = 'ONLINE', last_heartbeat_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
UPDATE asts_worker_node SET status = 'OFFLINE', updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE task_type_key = #{taskTypeKey} AND last_heartbeat_at < #{threshold} AND status != 'OFFLINE' AND is_deleted = 0
